summary: Validated the new 'Slip Click Preview' feature end-to-end. On /orders with Dispatched filter + search 'RUNECHA', the SlipHistory link data-testid=slip-history-link-f0304185-5cf5-4fe3-8930-49b4df74e3bf-0 ('Slip #938') opens data-testid=slip-preview-dialog. Dialog content verified to contain: Slip # 938, Date 02/10/2026, GR No 45-05885, Party RUNECHA AUTOMOBILES, transport DELHI HUBLI, both items (SIDE STAND SPLENDOR (A), SIDE STAND BAJAJ BOXER), Grand Total 800 pcs, Private mark='RA' (slip-private-mark), No. of bags=4 (slip-bag-count). Footer renders slip-print-btn + two share buttons (slip-share-email-open-btn, slip-share-whatsapp-open-btn) — share buttons were NOT clicked. slip-close-btn closes the dialog; user stays on /orders with filter still 'Dispatched'. All-status filter: order-brief-slip-link-{orderId}-0 opens the same dialog. Ledger regression (/dispatch-ledger): ledger-slip-search-input='938' + ledger-slip-search-btn opens the identical SlipPreviewDialog with all expected content and party RUNECHA AUTOMOBILES. Backend: GET /api/dispatches/by-slip/938 .customer now includes bill_number_mode=false and email='' as required.
critical_code_review_comments: SlipPreviewDialog.jsx recomputes bill/line/gst/grand/cash totals TWICE (once inside the table tfoot, once again inside the Bill/Cash box and once more inside the share payload). Extract into a single useMemo-derived object to prevent future drift between the on-screen numbers and the shared payload.

Orders.jsx openSlip() hard-codes the kind='dispatch' row shape used by SlipPreviewDialog but the component itself ignores row.kind — safe for now, dead field, consider removing to avoid confusing future readers.

The Pending filter path renders <SlipHistory onOpenSlip={openSlip}/> only when the order has slips; this is correct, but no visible tooltip tells partial-dispatch users that they can click the slip to preview it. Consider a one-line hint on first visit.

SlipPreviewDialog is now the single source of truth: /app/frontend/src/components/SlipPreviewDialog.jsx is consumed by Orders.jsx, DispatchLedger.jsx (slip search + row click).
